Fun With Numbers

by Corey Plover

ANSWER: RUN UP A SCORE / FEEL LIKE A MILLION

Zap Kaplow's final levels attained on each game are listed in the table below.

The supplementary information from 1983 reveals that in the alternate history, aliens reprogrammed all Atari games to use a base 27 numbering system, therefore changing the final levels attained on many of the games.

GameDescriptionBase 10Base 27
Asteroidsnumber of 2 digit, happy numbers17(21)10 = L
Berserksum of the digits in the largest 3 digit, palindromic, nonagonal number24(58)10 = 24
Centipedesum of the digits in the largest 3 digit, palindromic, centered decagonal number7(35)10 = 18

Inserting these values into the formulas gives value 182114, 2116, 1 and 1903151805 in the original history (which translates to RUN UP A SCORE by taking pairs of numbers alphanumerically) and FEEL LIKE A MILLION directly in the alternate history (using 0-9A-Q notation).


Notes:

  • Centipede is the digit sum of 151 for base 10 and (11761)10 = G3G for base 27
  • Enduro comprises 13, 31, 79 and 97 for base 10 and 7M, DM, M7 and MD for base 27
